AllowGrenadesThroughShields.label: Allow Grenades Through Shields
AllowGrenadesThroughShields.description: Allows grenades to pass through shield bubbles.

SafeRestLocation.label: Safe Rest Location
SafeRestLocation.description: Pawns (including animals) will only rest/sleep in safe locations without hazards like fire, pollution, or gas. They'll also avoid doors.

EnhanceArtilleryMarkers.label: Artillery Marker Enhancement
EnhanceArtilleryMarkers.description: Artillery and mortars will prioritize firing at targets with artillery markers. Other turrets gain a small accuracy boost when firing at marked targets.

AutoAvoidProximityActivators.label: Auto Avoid Proximity Activators
AutoAvoidProximityActivators.description: Pawns automatically avoid mechanoid proximity activators during pathfinding, similar to how they avoid fire. Prevents accidental triggering of dormant mechanoid clusters.

BuildAtCorners.label: Build at Corners
BuildAtCorners.description: Allow colonists to construct blueprints and frames placed at wall corners (the center of a + shape). In vanilla, such blueprints can be delivered to but never finished because no pawn can reach them through the diagonal.

EmergencyJobOverride.label: Emergency Jobs Override Schedule
EmergencyJobOverride.description: For emergency work (any WorkGiver flagged "[E]" — vanilla covers firefighting and urgent medical tending; mods may add more), dispatch the closest capable colonist regardless of schedule, waking them from sleep or pulling them off recreation as needed. Each emergency target is handled by at most one pawn, so the colony doesn't swarm a single fire.

AutoTargetMarksOnNonHostile.label: Auto Target Artillery Markers on Non-Hostile Entities
AutoTargetMarksOnNonHostile.description: Whether artillery and mortars should automatically target artillery markers on non-hostile entities (e.g., neutral animals or visitors).

EmergencyJobInterruptOngoingWork.label: Interrupt Ongoing Work for Emergencies
EmergencyJobInterruptOngoingWork.description: Also pull colonists off their current work job (mining, hauling, construction, etc.) when an emergency needs them. When disabled (default), only schedule-specific activities (e.g. resting, recreation) are interrupted.

EmergencyJobIgnoreAllowedArea.label: Ignore Allowed Area for Emergencies
EmergencyJobIgnoreAllowedArea.description: Allow emergency dispatch to send colonists outside their assigned allowed area.

WorkMemory.Title: Work Memory Moved to Its Own Mod
WorkMemory.Body.Enabled: Rimsonable's former "Work Memory" feature has been completely refactored. Given its current complexity, keeping it as a sub-feature under Rimsonable feels like a disservice, so I decided to set it free as a standalone mod: Work Memory. The updates include more reasonable default values, fully adjustable mathematical model parameters (the settings menu lets you preview how different parameters affect actual gameplay behavior), and multi-tier work memory. Click the button below to visit the Work Memory workshop page. Since you previously had Work Memory enabled in Rimsonable, you can also just click the subscribe and enable button to save some time.
WorkMemory.Body.Disabled: Rimsonable's former "Work Memory" feature has been completely refactored. Given its current complexity, keeping it as a sub-feature under Rimsonable feels like a disservice, so I decided to set it free as a standalone mod: Work Memory. The updates include more reasonable default values, fully adjustable mathematical model parameters (the settings menu lets you preview how different parameters affect actual gameplay behavior), and multi-tier work memory. Although you previously disabled Work Memory manually in Rimsonable, potentially because its original values were too aggressive and negatively impacted your gameplay experience, I still recommend checking out the new Work Memory on the workshop—you might change your mind.
WorkMemory.SubscribeQueued: Subscribed to Work Memory. RimWorld will enable it automatically after the download finishes.
WorkMemory.SubscribeNoSteam: Direct workshop subscription is only available when RimWorld is running through Steam. Opening the workshop page instead.
WorkMemory.SubscribeUnavailable: Work Memory's workshop item is not configured yet. Opening the workshop page instead.
WorkMemory.SubscribeFailed: RimWorld could not subscribe to Work Memory automatically. Opening the workshop page instead.
WorkMemory.EnableFailed: Work Memory finished downloading, but RimWorld could not find it in the installed mod list yet. Open the Mods menu after the download finishes and enable it manually.
WorkMemory.RestartPrompt: Work Memory has been enabled. RimWorld must restart before the new mod takes effect. Restart now?
